item.title: Luzerne County Domestic Relations completes relocation to Kingston
item.description: Luzerne County Domestic Relations completed its relocation to a leased building in Kingston, which frees up space for a $1.5 million project to fit all family court judicial operations inside the county-owned Bernard C. Brominski Building on North Street in Wilkes-Barre, officials said Monday.

item.title: PENNSYLVANIA ROUNDUP: Vehicle owners can take action to improve gas mileage, save money at the pumps
item.description: High gas prices have returned, rising sharply amid the recent conflict in the Middle East, leaving many drivers facing unexpectedly high pump prices.

item.title: NFL Free Agency: Kenneth Walker joins Mahomes in KC and Malik Willis starts QB reset in Miami, AP sources say
item.description: Super Bowl MVP Kenneth Walker III is the new running back for Patrick Mahomes in Kansas City, Miami settled on Malik Willis for a reset at quarterback and receiver Mike Evans is headed to San Francisco after 12 years in Tampa Bay.

item.title: Man who helped recruit players into a sprawling NCAA basketball point-shaving scheme pleads guilty
item.description: One of the so-called fixers in a sprawling betting scheme that allegedly raked in millions of dollars off of big bets on rigged NCAA basketball games pleaded guilty Monday.

item.title: Trump says Iran war could be over soon, then increases threats if global oil supplies are disrupted
item.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates — U.S. President Donald Trump said Monday that the war against Iran may be short-lived despite the country’s selection of a new hard-line supreme leader to oversee the fight for the Islamic theocracy’s survival.

item.title: Six WVC teams prepped for second round
item.description: All in all, the Wyoming Valley Conference fared quite well in the first round of the PIAA state basketball playoffs.

item.title: Plans for Wilkes-Barre Twp. warehouse move forward, developer agrees to revised traffic impact study
item.description: WILKES-BARRE TWP. — Bluecup Ventures LLC was in front of the Wilkes-Barre Township planning commission on Monday as construction plans move forward for the warehousing and distribution center it intends to build along Interstate 81 off Johnson Street.

item.title: Robin Abcarian: The Epstein files are off the front page, but far from yesterday’s news
item.description: I’m not saying definitively that going to war against Iran when there was no imminent threat is President Donald Trump’s way of distracting attention from the case of Jeffrey Epstein and his voluminous, sordid, incriminating files.
